xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: M/s HMA Agro Industries Ltd. was served with Demand-cum-Show Cause Notice No. 01/2021 dated 22nd April 2021 by the CGST & Central Excise Department (FY 2015-16), Agra. Despite the implementation of GST from 1st July 2017, the proceedings were initiated under Section 174 of the CGST Act. The Company submitted its response on 4th October 2021, requested a personal hearing, and sought withdrawal of the notice. The matter is presently pending before the Commissioner (Appeals), CGST, Lucknow.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The matter is currently pending in appeal at the Commissioner Appeals, Customs & GST, Lucknow.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: CGST and Central Excise Commissionerate(Appeals) Lucknow
